title: Frame

token.description: The client session token from /api/pair or /api/bootstrap. It never travels in a URL.

protocolVersion.description: A wire protocol version: one integer, bumped only on a breaking change.

clientKind.description: What kind of client a client session belongs to: the desktop window, the terminal UI, a browser tab, or a program (a script or bot driving the wire).

anyOf.description: From the client, first: its client session token, protocol version, kind and harness version.

protocolVersion.description: A wire protocol version: one integer, bumped only on a breaking change.

capabilities.description: The capabilities an environment offers, as a set; an absent flag means unsupported.

environmentId.description: An environment's persistent id: a UUID made on its first start, kept across address changes.

clientSessionId.description: A client session's id, as hello names it and the access methods list and revoke it.

items.description: One of the five scopes a method may require: read (list and subscribe), sessions:write (organisation commands), runs:drive (start, send, interrupt, answer prompts), terminal (terminals, files and diffs), admin (pairings, client sessions, drain, rebuild, settings).

scopes.description: The scopes a client session holds, as a non-empty set.

ceiling.description: The highest mode a client session may use; its values are the permissions workstream's.

serverTime.description: An instant as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

anyOf.description: From the environment, in reply to a valid auth: what the environment is and what this client session may do.

id.description: A request's id, chosen by the client and echoed by its response.

method.description: A registered method name, area.verb. A request on a stream method is a subscription.

params.description: The method's params, checked against its params schema after its scope.

anyOf.description: From the client: call a method, or subscribe when the method is a stream.

id.description: A request's id, chosen by the client and echoed by its response.
A request's id, chosen by the client and echoed by its response.

code.description: A stable error code in snake case.

error.description: An error as a response carries it: a stable code, a message and structured data.

anyOf.description: From the environment: a request's result, or its error, never both.

id.description: A request's id, chosen by the client and echoed by its response.

subscription.description: A subscription's id, chosen by the environment and carried by every subscription message.

anyOf.description: From the environment: the response to a stream request, naming the subscription its messages carry.

subscription.description: A subscription's id, chosen by the environment and carried by every subscription message.

sequence.description: A position in the event log's global sequence; 0 is the cursor before the first event.

anyOf.description: From the environment: at most one, first, when replay from the cursor is out of bounds; the state as of sequence.

subscription.description: A subscription's id, chosen by the environment and carried by every subscription message.

sequence.description: The event's global sequence; always equal to event.sequence.
The event's place in the log's global sequence, from 1.

streamKind.description: The kind of stream the event belongs to: environment, access, session, group, settings.

streamVersion.description: The event's place in its own stream, from 1.

type.description: What happened, area.verb in the past tense: pairing.created.

occurredAt.description: An instant as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

anyOf.description: The client-generated UUID every command takes; a retry with the same id applies once.

commandId.description: The command that produced the event; null when none did.

causationId.description: The event that caused this one; null when none did.

correlationId.description: The id every event of one piece of work shares; null when there is none.

kind.description: What caused the event: a client session, a routine, a provider adapter or the environment itself.

id.description: The actor's id within its kind; a system component names itself.

actor.description: Who caused an event: a client session, routine, adapter or system component.

payload.description: The event's data; its shape belongs to the stream's workstream.

event.description: One event on the environment's log, as every stream carries it.

anyOf.description: From the environment: one event of the subscription's stream. sequence equals event.sequence, a rule the decoder keeps and this schema cannot state.

subscription.description: A subscription's id, chosen by the environment and carried by every subscription message.

sequence.description: A position in the event log's global sequence; 0 is the cursor before the first event.

anyOf.description: From the environment: once, when catch-up is complete; live events follow.

subscription.description: A subscription's id, chosen by the environment and carried by every subscription message.

reason.description: Why a subscription ended: the client unsubscribed; it fell too far behind (resubscribe from its cursor); its client session was revoked; the connection closed; or what it follows was deleted (a session's subscription, after delivering session.deleted).

anyOf.description: From the environment: the subscription is over, and why.

subscription.description: A subscription's id, chosen by the environment and carried by every subscription message.

anyOf.description: From the client: end a subscription; answered by end with reason unsubscribed.
From the environment, every 15 seconds; the client arms its 45-second watchdog after the first.

reason.description: Why the environment is closing the connection: the token is invalid, foreign or unknown; it expired; the client session was revoked; the protocol versions differ; or the environment is draining or updating.

protocolVersion.description: The environment's own protocol version, sent with reason protocol so the client can name both.

anyOf.description: From the environment, before it closes the connection: why, so the client reconnects only when it should.

description: Any frame on the wire, told apart by its type.
